=== final rt_c_v_fill.c ===
/* rt_c_v_fill.c - Round-trip fixture: a fully filled V register across the
 * handoff (L11).
 *
 * Unlike rt_c_v_regs (e32 kernel, vl set from the data count), this fixture
 * fills v8 across ALL vlenb bytes (vsetvli AVL=VLMAX, e8/m1), so the drained
 * vreg slot is deterministic end to end at any VLEN. The old wire format
 * clamped the drain at 64 bytes per register; tests/hybrid/
 * e2e_vlen1024_drain.sh runs the QEMU leg at vlen=1024 and asserts the LAST
 * byte of v8 (vreg offset 1023 .. 1151 in the file) survives un-truncated.
 *
 * Phase 1 (QEMU1): v8 = 0xA5 repeated vlenb times, then the enter marker.
 * Phase 2 (vsim): the in-ROI self-check stores v8 and compares every byte;
 *   on mismatch it exits 1, so the vsim leg returns 1 instead of 200 and
 *   the harness fails loudly. On success v8 is refilled with the sentinel
 *   0x5A for StateDrain to capture at the exit marker.
 *
 * crt0.S sets mstatus.VS=Initial, so V is usable in M-mode on both engines.
 * The insns after the exit marker touch no V state, so the drain's 0-3 insn
 * halt slack cannot disturb the sentinel.
 */
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "runtime/rt_c_helpers.h"

#define FILL_BYTE 0xA5u
#define SENTINEL_BYTE 0x5Au

/* HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX mirror: big enough for VLEN 1024. */
static unsigned char buf[128];

/* vl=VLMAX at e8/m1 covers the whole register; returns vlenb. The "=&r"
 * early-clobber is required: vsetvli writes %0 before vmv.v.x reads %1,
 * so they must not share a register. */
static unsigned long fill_v8(unsigned long pattern)
{
  unsigned long vl;
  asm volatile("vsetvli %0, x0, e8, m1, ta, ma\n\t"
               "vmv.v.x v8, %1"
               : "=&r"(vl)
               : "r"(pattern));
  return vl;
}

static void store_v8(unsigned char *dst)
{
  unsigned long vl;
  asm volatile("vsetvli %0, x0, e8, m1, ta, ma\n\t"
               "vse8.v v8, (%1)"
               : "=&r"(vl)
               : "r"(dst)
               : "memory");
}

int main(void)
{
  /* Phase 1 (QEMU1): fill the full register width. */
  unsigned long vlenb = fill_v8(FILL_BYTE);
  if (vlenb > sizeof(buf))
    exit(2); /* engine wider than the wire format; should have aborted */

  enter_vsim();

  /* Phase 2 (vsim): every restored byte must carry the pattern. */
  store_v8(buf);
  for (unsigned long i = 0; i < vlenb; ++i)
    if (buf[i] != FILL_BYTE)
      exit(1);

  /* Leave a distinct value for the exit drain to capture. */
  fill_v8(SENTINEL_BYTE);

  exit_vsim();

  return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L11: a VLEN-1024 engine drains its full V registers -- no silent clamp.
#
# rt_c_v_fill fills v8 with 0xA5 across all vlenb bytes before the enter
# marker. The QEMU leg runs at vlen=1024 (vlenb=128, twice the old 64-byte
# wire ceiling); the plugin must drain vlenb=128 and the WHOLE register:
# the last byte of v8's slot would read 0 under the old clamp.
#
# Also pins the fast-standalone override surface: a user-supplied trailing
# `-cpu` (after `--`) replaces the built-in vlen=512, so
# `andesim run --mode fast` covers VLEN 128..1024 without a new flag.
#
# Manual TDD smoke; not auto-wired into scripts/run_e2e.sh (the fixture
# itself runs there via the normal marker/pc suite at the engine VLEN).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_v_fill}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}"

hybrid_resolve_paths

SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-vlen1024-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
read_u8()     { od -A n -j "$1" -N 1 -t u1 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
# Offsets locked by include/hybrid/state_abi_check.h (ceiling 128).
VLENB_OFF=1312
V8_FIRST=$((1320 + 8 * 128))        # vreg[8 * HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX]
V8_LAST=$((V8_FIRST + 127))         # byte 127: only present un-clamped

set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=1024 \
  -nographic \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_QEMU" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
QEMU1_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$QEMU1_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on marker drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]    || fail "QEMU 1 produced no state"

Q_VLENB=$(read_u64_le "$VLENB_OFF" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$Q_VLENB" -eq 128 ] \
  || fail "drained vlenb=$Q_VLENB, want 128 (VLEN 1024)"
ok "QEMU 1 drained vlenb=128 (VLEN 1024)"

B_FIRST=$(read_u8 "$V8_FIRST" "$STATE_QEMU")
B_LAST=$(read_u8 "$V8_LAST" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$B_FIRST" -eq 165 ] \
  || fail "v8 byte 0 = $B_FIRST, want 165 (0xA5) -- V drain broken?"
[ "$B_LAST" -eq 165 ] \
  || fail "v8 byte 127 = $B_LAST, want 165 (0xA5) -- upper half clamped (old 64-byte ceiling)?"
ok "v8 drained un-truncated across all 128 bytes"

# Fast-standalone surface: trailing -cpu (passthrough after --) overrides
# the built-in vlen=512; the fixture's self-check runs inline (markers are
# NOPs on the fast model) and main returns 0.
set +e
timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$TOP_ROOT/andesim" run --mode fast "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -- -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=1024 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
FAST_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$FAST_RC" -eq 0 ] \
  || fail "fast standalone at vlen=1024 exited $FAST_RC, want 0"
ok "fast standalone runs at vlen=1024 via trailing -cpu"

echo "PASS e2e_vlen1024_drain"

/* B7: pure decision function for the QEMU plugin V-state drain gate.
 *
 * The plugin uses one `qemu_plugin_register*` handle per architectural V
 * register. Each handle is non-NULL iff the gdbstub feature XML
 * advertised that register at plugin init. The original gate at
 * hybrid_handoff.c:296 tested `if (v->vlenb && s.vlenb > 0)` which
 * silently omits the V block when:
 *   - vlenb was not advertised but vtype/vl were (partial V), or
 *   - vlenb was advertised but read as zero (V disabled at runtime).
 *
 * Mixing the "stub broke" case with the "V disabled" case loses
 * information; the partial-advertisement case should refuse rather than
 * pretend V is absent (the resume side then mis-restores).
 *
 * This header is pure C, no QEMU plugin dependency, so it can be unit-
 * tested from a host C++ doctest.
 */
#ifndef HYBRID_V_DRAIN_POLICY_H
#define HYBRID_V_DRAIN_POLICY_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "hybrid/state_abi.h"  /* HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX: the L11 ceiling */

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef enum {
    HYBRID_V_DRAIN_OK = 0,      /* proceed: copy full V block into state */
    HYBRID_V_DRAIN_SKIP = 1,    /* no V at all; do not set HYBRID_FLAG_V */
    HYBRID_V_DRAIN_ABORT = 2,   /* partial advertisement; refuse to drain */
} HybridVDrainPolicy;

/* Decide whether to drain the V block.
 *
 * has_vlenb:    1 iff the stub advertised the vlenb register handle.
 * has_other_v:  1 iff ANY of vtype/vl/vstart/vxsat/vxrm/vcsr/vreg[*] was
 *               advertised (i.e. some V state is visible).
 * vlenb_value:  the value read from vlenb (only meaningful when has_vlenb).
 */
static inline HybridVDrainPolicy
hybrid_v_drain_policy(int has_vlenb, int has_other_v, uint64_t vlenb_value)
{
    /* Truth table (see v_drain_policy.test.cpp):
     *   has_vlenb=0, has_other_v=0            -> SKIP   (no V)
     *   has_vlenb=0, has_other_v=1            -> ABORT  (partial advertisement)
     *   has_vlenb=1, has_other_v=0            -> SKIP   (nothing to drain)
     *   has_vlenb=1, has_other_v=1, vlenb=0   -> SKIP   (V disabled at runtime)
     *   has_vlenb=1, has_other_v=1, vlenb>MAX -> ABORT  (L11: wire format
     *                                            cannot hold this VLEN; never
     *                                            truncate silently)
     *   has_vlenb=1, has_other_v=1, otherwise -> OK
     */
    if (!has_vlenb && has_other_v) return HYBRID_V_DRAIN_ABORT;
    if (!has_other_v)              return HYBRID_V_DRAIN_SKIP;
    if (vlenb_value == 0)          return HYBRID_V_DRAIN_SKIP;
    if (vlenb_value > HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX) return HYBRID_V_DRAIN_ABORT;
    return HYBRID_V_DRAIN_OK;
}

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif  /* HYBRID_V_DRAIN_POLICY_H */
